Items that are in Survival and Components tab in the Survivor's inventory (includes non-weapon equipment). Many of the items in this category are used in crafting in some way or another.

Essential items

The list of items below are grouped by items doing the same thing : only one is needed at a time.

Items in bold are essential, and should be picked-up in priority. It is advisable to drop other, less important items if needed.

Food and water should always be looted, but not to be carried everywhere. Water is quite heavy so leave extra amount behind the Survivor, in small camps outside cities, and only carry the quantity the Survivor need, according to his travel abilities. Canned food will grant him a can for further uses as utensils.

Medicine items are extremely useful and light-weight. The Survivor will need certain medicines for particular trauma or diseases. So loot it all, keep 10-20 of each with him at any time, keep the rest in camps.

See materials articles to check whether they're interesting to keep or not.

  • Getting wood - Hand, Axe, Rusted axe, Steel axe, Polar axe, Flint axe and Chainsaw
  • Looting/Disassembling tools - took kit, steel tools, crowbar, steel crowbar, hacksaw, shovel, steel shovel, Rusted Crowbar, Rusted shovel, Rusted tools, Rusted hacksaw
  • Fire crafting - lighter, matches, handmade lighter
  • Cooking, portable fire - primus stove, handmade primus stove
  • Cooking pots - can, saucepan, iron pot, steel pot
  • Cooking tools - knife, kitchen knife, steel knife
  • Health, equipment - sewing needle, handmade needle, rusted needle
  • Resting - tent
  • Chemistry/Tools - chemistry set, Insulating Tape
  • Backpack - tourist backpack, knapsack, schoolbag, sack

This category has only the following subcategory.
